items.followUp: What is a parasite? Name two parasites that live inside their hosts.

rubric.why: A parasite lives on or inside a host and obtains nourishment from it.
rubric.description: Defines a parasite in relation to its host and food source.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that it lives on or inside a host and obtains food or nutrients from the host.

rubric.description: Gives two correct examples of parasites.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming any two parasites.

modelAnswer: A parasite is an organism that lives on or inside another organism, called its host, and obtains food from it.
